I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. The reply says I've noted that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is on 25 November, and that no action was taken.

That reply overstates one thing: it says "logged it for my records," but I didn't save the date to a file or anywhere else. Right now it's recorded only in Ilse's message and my reply in the channel. As she asked, I took no other action.
